motion.name: row-hover
motion.purpose: Brief file-row hover feedback; removed when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action for uploads, account changes and confirmations.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 500 14px system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 140ms ease-out, transform 140ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary and reversible actions beside primary controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 5px; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font: 500 14px system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 140ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Account, password and settings form field.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 43px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: 5px; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font: 400 14px system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); opacity: 1; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring); outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: .5; }

components.name: Active Navigation
components.description: Current destination in the desktop rail or mobile navigation strip.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; padding: 11px 14px; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--primary); font: 500 14px system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-active:hover { background: var(--secondary); } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: File Row
components.description: Open workspace row with stable name, size and action columns.
components.css: .ds-file-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) 116px 44px; align-items: center; column-gap: 16px; min-height: 59px; padding: 0 7px 0 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--foreground); font: 400 14px system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 140ms ease-out; } .ds-file-row:hover, .ds-file-row:focus-within { background: var(--muted); } .ds-file-row small { color: var(--muted-foreground); text-align: right; font-size: 13px; } .ds-row-action { min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); } .ds-row-action svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-row-action:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-row-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
Sylux gives stored files the visual priority. A slim header and compact destination navigation frame a broad working area; file names align in rows, while thin separators and restrained tonal shifts provide grouping. The result is familiar and low-noise for occasional file and account tasks.

The interface uses system sans-serif type, small control corners and a muted teal accent for actions and current locations. Light and dark themes share the same semantic roles. Copy stays short and factual, with consequences stated near account or file actions. The production design reflects the accepted file-manager direction; prototype documentation remains historical and separate.
keyCharacteristics: Files occupy open, aligned rows instead of a large enclosing panel.
Teal marks primary actions and active destinations; neutral planes carry the rest.
The same shell supports file work, personal account details and administrator settings.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Reserve teal for primary actions, links and the current destination; keep routine file surfaces neutral.

rules.name: The System Face Rule
rules.body: Use the platform sans-serif stack throughout; hierarchy comes from size and weight rather than a decorative face.

rules.name: The Open Workspace Rule
rules.body: Let rows and section separators organize content; avoid enclosing the full file workspace in a card.

dos: Do keep file names visually dominant and actions grouped in the toolbar or row menu.
Do use teal for primary actions and the current location.
Do keep account and administrator settings in the same restrained workspace shell.
Do state account and file consequences in concise nearby copy.
donts: Don't wrap the main file workspace in a large enclosing card.
Don't add promotional sign-in copy, fake capacity figures or unsupported security claims.
Don't add shadows to ordinary resting surfaces.
